submission.causalMechanism: The Host-assigned actor's system prompt (line 369-370) demands that candidate_completed conclusions have an empty unresolved_unknowns array, directly suppressing the model's expression of world uncertainty. Independently, when recording the run (line 685-689), the code builds a fresh conclusion object with "unresolved_unknowns": [] hard-coded, discarding any unresolved_unknowns value that the Harness result.conclusion may have carried. The Harness's own conclusion object (result.conclusion) is read at line 447-451 but only its summary is extracted into evidence.rationale; its unresolved_unknowns field is never read or propagated. Together these two Security-owned decisions (prompt enforcement plus hard-coded empty record) deterministically empty unresolved_unknowns on completion without altering Harness core turn-loop semantics.
